title: 美国零售商财报报喜 节前消费需求显韧性
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: But what's the message we're getting this morning? Yeah, I mean, each retailer has a sort of different story.
segments.zh: 但今早我们得到什么信息？每家零售商情况不同。

segments.en: I think all point to the strength and the consumer consumers that are picky yet spending.
segments.zh: 我认为都指向消费者强劲，虽挑剔但仍在消费。

segments.en: I think let's start with Dix. I mean, Dix had a terrible quarter, last quarter.
segments.zh: 先从Dix开始，上季度表现糟糕。

segments.en: And the CEO warned us that there was pain to come.
And these results point to a little bit of optimism there.
segments.zh: 这些业绩显示一些乐观迹象。

segments.en: Strength from Nike, strength from Foot Locker.
So not as bad as anticipated, which is I think why we're seeing that surge.
segments.zh: 所以没预期那么差，这就是股价大涨的原因。

segments.en: So it's a consumer that's still healthy, that's still spending. Although being more selected, because they like value deals, at least based on the earnings report.
segments.zh: 消费者仍健康、仍在支出，但更挑剔，喜欢实惠交易，至少财报显示如此。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, Dix said like a strong back to school season, which for a lot of retailers is a good sign heading into the holiday season.
segments.zh: Dix称返校季强劲，对许多零售商是假日季的好兆头。

segments.en: That's a bell weather. But how will it help the holiday season ahead?
segments.zh: 这是风向标。但它将如何助力即将到来的假日季？

segments.en: Do you think that will see a strengthening consumer base there? And will it help corporate earnings for next year?
segments.zh: 你认为当地消费群体是否会增强？这是否有助于明年的企业盈利？

segments.en: Dix is saying yes, I think best by similar story.
segments.zh: Dix表示认同，我认为Best Buy也有类似情况。

segments.en: They have a lot of wind helping them right now with the new Grand Theft Auto game.
segments.zh: 他们目前受益于新《侠盗猎车手》游戏的助力。

segments.en: You need a new PlayStation to play that games where people are going to get that.
segments.zh: 玩这款游戏需要新的PlayStation，人们会去购买。

segments.en: And other accessories to go with their gaming needs.
segments.zh: 以及满足游戏需求的其他配件。

segments.en: So that's giving them strength heading into the holiday season as well.
segments.zh: 这也为他们在假日季前提供了支撑。

segments.en: Perhaps for a lot of these retailers, though, they also have a different element coming to them.
segments.zh: 不过，对许多这类零售商而言，他们还面临另一个不同因素。
